chunks: And it is narrated in another report:

That he is fed fresh fish for three days, then it is said to him: Urinate upon ashes. So if his urine pierces the ashes, then he is not impotent; and if his urine does not pierce the ashes, then he is impotent.

key_terms.الرَّمَادِ: ashes, the substance used in the test
key_terms.السَّمَكَ: fish used here as part of the described test
key_terms.بُلْ: urinate, the instruction given in the report

ai.seo_question: How is impotence in a husband determined in this hadith from Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This report describes a legal diagnostic method mentioned concerning the determination of impotence in a husband. Its significance lies in its use within jurisprudential discussion related to marital rulings and spousal rights.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4893 - In another narration, it is reported:

"The man is to be fed fresh fish for three days, and then he is instructed to urinate on ashes. If his urine penetrates through the ashes, he is not impotent. However, if his urine does not penetrate the ashes, then he is indeed impotent."
